name: Priya tells it in one breath, picks a car, then corrects it

turns.caller: KP731508, and I was born on the 23rd of January 1992.
Yesterday afternoon in the Tesco car park in Leeds, someone scraped my door. Nobody was hurt, no police, the other driver left a note, and it still drives.
expect: Which car was it: the white Kia Niro or the black Ford Fiesta?
Shall I file your claim for the white Kia Niro

turns.caller: Actually, sorry, it was the Fiesta.
expect: Shall I file your claim for the black Ford Fiesta
